# Gambit

> Gambit (Gambit Technology Inc.) builds AI workers that run business operations. Not chatbots, not copilots: AI workers with a job title, a scope, and accountability to an outcome. Founded in 2023, headquartered in Canada, live across financial services, healthcare, public sector, legal, logistics, hospitality, and business services. Tagline: We put AI to work.

## What Gambit Does

Gambit builds and runs custom AI workers alongside your team. Each worker is built for a specific job, runs 24/7 across web, SMS, voice, and phone, and is accountable to a business outcome, not a seat license. Workers run on The Factory, Gambit's platform: your infrastructure, any model routed per task, every action auditable, SOC 2, and no vendor or model lock-in. Gambit's vision: help companies do ten times more with the teams they already have, and build AI that the customer owns.

## Key Facts

- 15+ AI workers deployed in production
- AskEllyn: 100,000+ conversations across 100+ countries in 50+ languages, live on Cigna Healthcare
- Fleet confirms freight loads in about 3 minutes each for Logistics Alliance
- Clients include Cigna Healthcare, Town of Vail, Spearhead Corporate Development, OceanPark, Geotab, Logistics Alliance, Burnbrae Farms, Infiniti Group, Gillis Sales, Pulse Law LLP
- Partnerships: HPE Unleash AI program member, TD SYNNEX approved ISV, NVIDIA Inception Program
- Named a FoundersBeta Top 100 Company to Watch in 2026
- SOC 2 compliant, runs on customer infrastructure, model-agnostic

## AI Workers

### Growth and M&A
- [Mira](https://gambitco.io/workers/mira): Research worker. Works up any company or market on demand, verifies primary sources, scores fit against your thesis, and delivers a cited brief.
- [Bogan](https://gambitco.io/workers/bogan): Buy-side origination worker for Spearhead Corporate Development. Reads public signals, finds owners likely to sell, verifies decision makers, and drafts first-touch outreach.
- [Atlas](https://gambitco.io/workers/atlas): Sell-side worker built with OceanPark. Maps every strategic and financial buyer for a mandate, scores fit, and runs the process.
- [Dealio](https://gambitco.io/workers/dealio): Post-LOI deal room worker. Runs diligence and coordinates lawyers, accountants, and lenders so a signed LOI reaches close in weeks.
- [Gillis](https://gambitco.io/workers/gillis): Hotel sales worker (GillisOS) for Gillis Sales. Finds hotel demand within five miles of each property and opens conversations with outreach that reads handwritten.

### Operations
- [Jericho](https://gambitco.io/workers/jericho): Support worker. Answers inbound across web, SMS, and voice around the clock.
- [Chloe](https://gambitco.io/workers/chloe): Smart Cities voice concierge, live for the Town of Vail. Answers residents and visitors by phone at (970) 645-VAIL, in multiple languages.
- [Fleet](https://gambitco.io/workers/fleet): Freight coordinator for Logistics Alliance. Reads load documents with AI vision, validates them, matches carriers, and confirms loads in about 3 minutes.
- [AskTodd](https://gambitco.io/legal): Legal intake and research worker built with Pulse Law LLP. Client orientation, consultation preparation, and research, 24/7.
- [Demi](https://gambitco.io/workers/demi): HR advisor. Policy and benefits questions, onboarding, and HR case handling.

### Care
- [AskEllyn](https://gambitco.io/workers/askellyn): Patient companion for breast cancer support, built on the lived experience of survivor Ellyn Winters-Robinson. Live on Cigna Healthcare and open to anyone at askellyn.ai.
- [Dawn](https://gambitco.io/workers/dawn): Recovery platform behind Chaddict (chaddict.com, for Infiniti Group) and AskEvaMarie (askevamarie.com, for NEM Recovery Centers), companions for addiction and recovery built on real lived experience.
- [Ayla](https://gambitco.io/workers/ayla): Free companion for parents and caregivers raising a child with a disability.
- [AskAshleigh](https://gambitco.io/workers/askashleigh): Around-the-clock caregiver support built for the U.S. Area Agency on Aging network.
- [Clinic](https://gambitco.io/workers/clinic): Hospital pilot. Runs the specialist consult, shows its reasoning, and drafts the clinical note while the clinician stays in charge.

### Also live
- AskAmber (askamber.io): A professional race car driver's fan companion, on-brand and sponsor-safe.
- AskBibi: Sales assistant for Bobit Business Media that builds cross-service advertising packages.
- Geotab Assistant: Builds customized sponsorship packages in real time, launched at Geotab Connect.

## Industries

- [Financial Services](https://gambitco.io/financial-services): Private equity, investment banking, and wealth. Origination, sell-side, post-LOI execution, research, and support.
- [Healthcare](https://gambitco.io/healthcare): Care companions grounded in lived experience, non-medical by design, with clinical guardrails.
- [Public Sector](https://gambitco.io/public-sector): Resident services answered the first time, any hour.
- [Legal](https://gambitco.io/legal): Intake, research, and client questions without the wait.
- [Logistics](https://gambitco.io/logistics): Freight documents read, validated, and confirmed at machine speed.
- [Hospitality and Entertainment](https://gambitco.io/hospitality): Hotel demand found and fans answered around the clock.
- [Business Services](https://gambitco.io/business-services): Outbound, qualification, and support without added headcount.

## Platform

- [The Factory](https://gambitco.io/factory): The engine every worker runs on. Build one worker, then many. Runs on your infrastructure, any model routed per task, every action auditable.
- [Vision](https://gambitco.io/vision): 10x your operations, own your AI, no vendor or model lock-in, a partner as you scale.

## How It Works

1. Tell Gambit the problem: the task or workflow that eats your team's time.
2. Gambit scopes the worker: what it would do, on your data and your channels.
3. See a working proof in weeks, judged on real output.
4. The worker runs 24/7 with human oversight, and Gambit operates it with you as you scale.
